method: Google Maps in Chrome: 20 searches (supermarket, potraviny, grocery, every chain name, večerka, řeznictví, bio, asijské potraviny, farmářský trh) around both places; walking time from Google directions; tram/bus time for Tuesday 20/10/2026 10:00 (measured for chain stores only). Kept: every food shop within 30 min on foot, chain stores further away with their tram/bus time, the nearest store of every chain (incl. Žabka, Zeman). Westfield's own list of food shops added. Delivery services: address typed into Wolt, foodora and Košík (lookup only), Rohlík through its connector. Freshness: cards/google-maps.md.

bands.transit: walk over 30 min or not measured: tram or bus
